scenario: An HR analyst processes an employee's annual performance review cycle: interview-analysis extracts and scores competency evidence from the manager's written review narrative and the employee's self-assessment, emotion-detector assesses the emotional tone of the manager's free-text comments to surface any sentiment bias in the evaluation, and reporting synthesizes a promotion eligibility memo summarizing the competency scores, sentiment analysis, and a final promotion recommendation.
info_flow: interview-analysis parses the manager review narrative and self-assessment to produce a structured competency scorecard → emotion-detector scores the emotional valence and intensity of manager free-text comments → reporting reads both outputs and generates a promotion eligibility memo with a final recommendation.
